title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #021 · 매체+명화 믹스 · 동심원·매끈 · 4영역(팝아트 코믹+몬드리안+유화 임파스토+마티스) · 풀커버 · towering hourglass · 와이드 스탠스 · Russian · 배경 쇼핑 아케이드 · 오네에갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, late 30s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, wolf cut platinum silver hair — her body is painted in 4 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 58% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 36%, 64% and 85% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries pop-art comic panels with bold black outlines, flat red, yellow and blue shapes and big speech bursts. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick black lines with flat blocks of primary red, yellow and blue and white. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries thick impasto oil paint in cadmium yellow and viridian, heavy palette-knife ridges catching the light. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries Matisse style paper cut-out shapes, bold seaweed-like leaf forms in flat cobalt blue, coral and yellow. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing in a wide stance facing the camera straight on, both hands resting on her flared hips, her legs fully in view — most extreme towering hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her whole hand, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a bright glass-vaulted shopping arcade with a polished marble floor, standard-height shop doors and a long bench, completely empty, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
